facts.fact: Le Defi Media reports, quoting Ministry of Health adviser Keshav Jokhun, that E-Health holds one national electronic record per patient, found by national identity card and consulted by staff at any other connected public facility.
Le Defi Media reports E-Health is in pilot in about thirty public health facilities of the East and Centre, with over 150,000 patients registered.
The Ministry of Health says over one million electronic transactions were made from January to September 2026 and Phase 1 operational acceptance is planned by December 2026.
